'''Casey's Beedrill''' (Japanese: '''ナナコのスピアー''' ''Nanako's Spear'') was the sixth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that {{Ash}} {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Johto]] [[region]], and his twentieth overall. It was later given to {{an|Casey}}.

==In animation==
===History===
[[File:Ash giving Beedrill away.png|thumb|left|220px|Ash giving Beedrill to Casey]]
===={{aniseries|GS}}====
Ash caught Beedrill in the [[Bug-Catching Contest]] in ''[[EP161|The Bug Stops Here]]''. In catching it, he won the contest, and, according to the rules, the winner is allowed to keep the Pokémon that was caught. However, Ash chose to give Beedrill to {{an|Casey}} afterwards because of her love for yellow and black-striped {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}. It has since become one of her three main Pokémon, along with {{TP|Casey|Meganium}} and {{p|Elekid}}.

====[[Pokémon Chronicles]]====
In ''[[HS17|Those Darn Electabuzz!]]'', Beedrill was seen sleeping with Meganium and Elekid, and got angry when Don, a {{p|Charizard}}, was on a rampage. It also cheered the {{p|Electabuzz}} [[baseball]] team theme song with Casey and her other {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}.
{{-}}

===Personality and characteristics===
[[File:HS17.png|thumb|220px|Beedrill and Casey]]
Due to appearing only very shortly before being caught, Beedrill's original nature remains uncertain, although it was shown possessing aggressive characteristics typical to its species while attacking Ash. After joining Casey's team, it seems to have adopted Casey's confident and cheerful attitude, eagerly joining Casey, Meganium, and Elekid in performing the Electabuzz theme song.

==In the manga==
[[File:Ash Beedrill EToP.png|200px|thumb|Beedrill in [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]]]]
===The Electric Tale of Pikachu===
[[Ash Ketchum (EToP)|Ash]] caught a Beedrill in ''[[ET03|Clefairy Tale]]'', although it was never seen being used. He thought this Beedrill would help him to raise his Trainer rank, but it couldn't.
{{-}}

==Trivia==
* Beedrill is the only Pokémon Ash {{pkmn2|caught}} that he has [[Gift Pokémon|given away]].
* Beedrill is the first Pokémon from a three-stage evolutionary line that Ash caught in its fully evolved form.
